title: Coalesce duplicate exact wait-status reads across visible UI surfaces
outcome: Simultaneously mounted visible wait surfaces reuse their bounded exact-status reads without creating background history scans or a durable run index, and without changing wait settlement.
acceptance: With multiple visible consumers for the same wait, controlled API observations show exact-status reads are coalesced while distinct wait identities and server revisions remain correctly isolated.
Closing or hiding consumers cancels unused demand; no global history scan, stale reply adoption, or change to backend wait semantics is introduced.
